title: ABNAT: Attention-Based Noise-Aware Training for Robust Transformers on Analog Compute-in-Memory Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.22065v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Transformer-based models have become the backbone of a wide range of tasks, but their intensive computation and data movement incur substantial energy overhead. Analog compute-in-memory (CIM) offers an energy-efficient alternative, yet its inherent hardware non-idealities perturb stored weights and can significantly degrade model performance. Although existing noise-aware training (NAT) methods improve robustness by injecting noise during training, they largely overlook the critical role of attention mechanisms in Transformer inference.To bridge this gap, we analyze how CIM-induced noise reshapes attention in Transformers and identify two key observations: (1) the divergence between clean and noisy attention maps increases substantially in deeper layers, and (2) conventional NAT can remain overconfident even when its attention routes deviate markedly from the clean reference. translated_abstract: 基于Transformer的模型已成为众多任务的支柱，但其密集的计算和数据搬运带来了巨大的能耗开销。模拟存内计算（CIM）提供了一种高能效的替代方案，然而其固有的硬件非理想性会扰动存储的权重，并可能显著降低模型性能。尽管现有的噪声感知训练（NAT）方法通过在训练期间注入噪声来提升鲁棒性，但它们在很大程度上忽视了注意力机制在Transformer推理中的关键作用。为弥合这一差距，我们分析了CIM引起的噪声如何重塑Transformer中的注意力，并得到两个关键观察结果：（1）干净与带噪注意力图之间的差异在更深层中显著增大；（2）即使注意力路由明显偏离干净参考，传统NAT仍可能保持过度自信。受这些发现启发，我们提出了ABNAT，一种基于注意力的（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出ABNAT，一种基于注意力的噪声感知训练方法，通过分析模拟存内计算噪声如何重塑Transformer注意力机制（发现深层注意力差异增大且传统NAT存在过度自信问题），显著提升Transformer在模拟CIM硬件上的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: ABNAT is an attention-based noise-aware training method that leverages two key insights—attention map divergence grows in deeper layers and conventional NAT remains overconfident—to improve the robustness of Transformers on analog compute-in-memory systems.
